summary: Proteins Plus is a supplier of bulk plant-based protein ingredients for human food, pet food, and animal feed manufacturing. They manage sourcing and logistics, offering an international network for supply chain needs. The company also provides scientific and application services, specializing in low-allergen, non-GMO plant proteins for various food and beverage products.

name: Nature's Fynd
summary: Nature's Fynd is a food technology company that produces a novel vegan protein called Fy Protein™, derived from extremophiles found in Yellowstone National Park. They utilize fermentation to create nutrient-dense products like Meatless Fy™ Breakfast Patties and Dairy-Free Fy Yogurt. The company aims to revolutionize food production with sustainable, fungi-powered nutrition, with culinary guidance from Chef Eric Ripert.

name: ADM SojaProtein
summary: ADM SojaProtein is a leading European producer of high-quality, non-GMO soy-based ingredients for the food, beverage, animal feed, and pharmaceutical industries. Acquired by ADM in 2022, it leverages local European sourcing and ADM's global expertise to provide innovative, sustainable, and consumer-preferred plant-based solutions. The company focuses on delivering high-performance soy protein ingredients with a commitment to quality and rapid market entry for its partners.

name: New Protein Global Inc.
summary: New Protein Global Inc. specializes in producing hexane-free, food-grade soy protein ingredients for the food industry using a proprietary BioPur™ extraction process. They offer a range of soy protein isolates, concentrates, textured soy proteins, and soy flours, positioning themselves as a provider of next-generation plant-based proteins. The company focuses on clean-label products and operates on a commercial scale to meet global market demand.

name: BiomassProtein™
summary: BiomassProtein™ is developing a sustainable plant protein brand by designing, manufacturing, selling, and distributing plant proteins with superior digestibility and content. They utilize a patent-pending technology to extract proteins from grass and offer turn-key franchise agreements for establishing sustainable plant protein factories. Their products are intended for both animal feed and human food applications, addressing a growing global demand.

name: Organic Plant Protein A/S
summary: Organic Plant Protein A/S is a Danish company focused on developing and producing high-quality, sustainable, plant-based proteins. Their flagship product, Plant Mate™ SunbeanPRO®, offers a complete protein with a mild taste and meat-like texture, free from common allergens. The company aims to facilitate a shift towards healthier and more environmentally friendly diets by providing innovative ingredients for various food applications.

name: SunLife Organics
summary: SunLife Organics is an e-commerce company specializing in organic health and wellness products, primarily protein powders and related merchandise. They offer both vegan and grass-fed whey protein options, alongside apparel and accessories. The company focuses on providing high-quality, organic products and aims to build a community through its online presence and customer service.

name: 株式会社アルプロン (Alpron Co., Ltd.)
summary: 株式会社アルプロン (Alpron Co., Ltd.) is a Japanese company focused on producing and selling protein products and addressing environmental issues. They emphasize domestic production of safe and secure protein and are involved in initiatives to solve protein crises and global environmental challenges. The company also offers OEM services for protein products and raw material sales.

name: Protei.co OÜ
summary: Protei.co is a company focused on producing and supplying premium, innovative, and sustainable proteins derived from entomological or fermentation processes. Their products, including larvae meal, single-cell fermentation proteins, and insect-based ingredients, are designed for animal feed, pet food, and aquaculture, with potential applications in human nutrition. The company emphasizes reducing environmental impact through minimized land and water usage, lower CO2 emissions, and circular economy principles, aligning with global sustainability goals.

name: Unknown
summary: This company is developing a novel method for producing cheese by growing milk proteins in plants, rather than using traditional dairy farming. Their goal is to replicate the taste, melt, and stretch of dairy cheese while offering a more sustainable and environmentally friendly alternative. The company aims to capitalize on the rapidly growing demand for non-dairy cheese alternatives.

name: Proteine Resources
summary: Proteine Resources is a biotechnology company specializing in the production of insect-based proteins for the pet food industry. They offer sustainable and highly palatable protein solutions, including flakes and smoothies, designed to enhance pet health and reduce environmental impact. Their patented rearing methods and autonomous, carbon-negative facilities aim to set a new standard for eco-friendly animal nutrition.

name: Eighth Day Foods
summary: Eighth Day Foods has developed a proprietary technology called Rapid Solid-State Fermentation to produce plant-based proteins from pulses and seeds. This innovative process aims to overcome the cost, complexity, and scalability challenges associated with existing plant-based protein production methods. Their solution offers a sustainable, affordable, and nutritious protein source with enhanced bioavailability, produced in a single day from raw ingredients.

name: Tomorrow Foods
summary: Tomorrow Foods develops and supplies plant-based protein systems and integrated solutions for the food industry. Their offerings enable clients to easily launch rich, healthy, and sustainable food products. The company's mission is to provide innovative solutions for healthier and more sustainable lives, focusing on plant-based ingredients that cater to evolving consumer demands for diverse, well-rounded, and eco-friendly diets.

name: Integrated Proteins™
summary: Integrated Proteins™ is a leader in pet food ingredient sourcing and trading, specializing in refining and blending custom protein products. They offer a wide range of monospecies protein meals, including exotic and hard-to-find options, and have developed an innovative refining method called NutriPure™ to create clean, nutritionally consistent premium ingredients. The company emphasizes exceptional customer service and sustainability in its operations.

name: Bond Pet Foods
summary: Bond Pet Foods produces sustainable, scalable, and nutritionally complete meat proteins for the pet food industry. Utilizing a brewing-like process, they create high-value proteins from sources like chicken, lamb, and salmon with significantly reduced resource and carbon intensity. Their mission is to provide innovative protein solutions that support pet health while minimizing environmental impact.

name: Silk
summary: Silk is a brand that produces and markets a variety of plant-based dairy alternatives, including beverages, creamers, and yogurt alternatives. Their products are made from ingredients like almonds, oats, and soy, offering options that are dairy-free and often lower in sugar than traditional dairy products. Silk focuses on providing plant-powered nutrition for consumers seeking healthier and more sustainable food choices.

name: AM Nutrition
summary: AM Nutrition is a company that produces natural, healthy, and functional ingredients derived from yellow peas. They fractionate peas into protein concentrate, starch concentrate, and hull fiber for use in food, feed, pet food, and technical applications. Their environmentally friendly, dry processing technology uses no water or chemicals and has low energy consumption, emphasizing sustainability. The company holds multiple certifications including ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, GMP+, and organic producer status.

name: European Protein A/S
summary: European Protein is a Danish family-owned company specializing in the production of lacto-fermented plant proteins for animal feed. Their products aim to improve the health and productivity of various animal categories, including sows, weaners, broilers, laying hens, and game birds. The company operates multiple protein factories globally and is GMP+ FSA and GMP+ FRA certified.

name: Natural Proteins
summary: Natural Proteins specializes in the collection, rendering, and global distribution of animal by-products, transforming them into valuable proteins, oils, and fats. These ingredients are supplied to manufacturers of animal feed, pet food, aqua feed, and biodiesel. The company also offers consulting and engineering services for rendering facilities, aiming to optimize by-product processing and contribute to a circular economy.

name: Vitalfactory
summary: Vitalfactory is an e-shop specializing in natural protein supplements, nut butters, sweeteners, healthy foods, and superfoods. The company aims to help individuals achieve fitness goals such as muscle gain or weight loss by providing high-quality, natural protein sources. They have recently launched a new e-shop and introduced new products, including lupin protein.

name: Sunbloom Proteins
summary: Sunbloom Proteins produces and markets functional and nutritional proteins derived from sunflower seeds, serving as an ingredient for the food industry. Their mission is to support the transition towards more plant-based diets by offering sustainable and tasty solutions. The company focuses on transforming sunflower protein for applications in plant-based dairy, desserts, savory products, and general nutrition.

name: 株式会社プローバル (Pローバル Co., Ltd.)
summary: 株式会社プローバル (Pローバル Co., Ltd.) is a Japanese company specializing in the production, import, and sale of food ingredients, including health foods, supplements, and protein powders. They also offer OEM (contract manufacturing) services for food products. The company focuses on sourcing unique and interesting ingredients to provide innovative solutions to the food industry, aiming to offer exciting and novel products.

name: ADM
summary: ADM is a global leader in human and animal nutrition and the agricultural origination and processing industry. They offer a wide range of products and services including ingredients for human food, animal feed, pet food, and industrial applications. ADM also provides transportation and logistics services, and invests in agricultural technology startups, aiming to nourish the world and drive sustainable solutions.
